information: This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdE5vIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9b651c23dcc747ccdb28197dc74dae96d455cfa7/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) This competition is also collaborating with the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series and [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking any competitors that wish to support, please bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer | Ethan's Ohana](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CincinnatiSpeedsolving2026#71790-cube-against-cancer-ethan-s-ohana) tab for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzMTk2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a9773d88090b74ba43a56dd449c98881be6dc957/image.png)
